mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.seed_money AS seedMoney, a.cash_balance AS cashBalance, COALESCE(SUM(hs.quantity * hs.average_price), 0) AS stockAsset FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN holding_securities hs ON hs.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY a.account_id, a.seed_money, a.cash_balance LIMIT 1
